title: VoiceRewriterQueueEnvelope
description: Queue task envelope schema supporting optimistic concurrency control (OCC), leases, and least privilege.

job_id.description: Unique identifier of the target job.

queue_revision.description: Revision or SHA token for Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC).

claim_status.description: Strict Queue Lifecycle state of the worker execution.

claim_owner.description: Worker identifier currently holding the claim lease, or null if unclaimed.

claimed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the claim was acquired, or null.

lease_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the current lease expires, or null.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key preventing duplicate processing of the same stage iteration.

iteration.description: Job iteration counter at time of queuing.

authorized_inputs.description: Sanitized inputs authorized specifically for this worker (Least Privilege).

expected_output_path.description: Path where the worker must persist its primary artifact.
